tools.name: read_web_page
tools.description:
Reads a public web page and returns its title and main text as clean plain text (menus, scripts and ads removed), in pages of up to 50,000 characters.
Use when: you need the content of an article, a documentation page, a blog post or any public page.
Not for: pages that need a login; PDFs (use the F

tools.name: read_github_file

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "reader" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_web_page · Private data: read_github_file · Public sink: read_web_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_web_page · Private data: read_github_file · Public sink: read_web_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
